name: Pinet (Spain)
description: White field with a red triangle at the hoist bearing a white tower topped with a flag, charged at the fly with a green pine.
history: The official flag of Pinet is of proportions 2:3, enté at the hoist of red, bearing a tower of silver or pearl grey masoned and pierced sable and surmounted by a flag of silver or pearl grey, the rest silver with a pine vert; it was approved by resolution of 2 August 2007 of the First Vice-President and Conseller of the Presidency and published in the DOCV. The arms, approved by resolution of 13 March 2000, are the traditional arms of the town, representing the castle of Xiu.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
tower topped with a white flag on the triangle
